Checked via extra_mirrors.py, which caches results in wayback_cache.json and is safe to re-run (network congestion in this sandbox left some candidates unresolved on a given run -- transient failures are never cached as negatives, so a re-run keeps retrying them rather than needing a fresh investigation).

All of releases.json now has at least one mirror per entry. wayback_cache.json holds the per-URL results; re-run catalog/dotnet/extra_mirrors.py if new entries are added later.

investigated_not_actionable.issue: dotnet 7.0.20 macOS runtime (osx-x64 and osx-arm64, both .pkg and .tar.gz) currently serves bytes that do NOT match the sha512 recorded in releases.json/checksum -- confirmed independently (full download of dotnet-runtime-7.0.20-osx-x64.tar.gz, sha512 mismatch against the vendor value in the metadata). This matches a known public report (MacPorts ticket #68580) of Microsoft re-releasing 7.0.x macOS binaries without republishing the checksum.
investigated_not_actionable.wayback_finding: Internet Archive's earliest capture of both builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/.../dotnet-runtime-7.0.20-osx-{arm64,x64}.tar.gz is 2025-07-09 -- already years after the original 2024-05-28 release -- and every capture from 2025-07 through 2026-09 carries the SAME digest as the file served live today (i.e. the same mismatched bytes). No 2024 capture exists for either URL, and dotnetcli.blob.core.windows.net (the other historical host for this content) has ZERO Wayback captures at all. There is therefore no Wayback copy of the originally-published, checksum-matching bytes to add as a mirror for these two entries; the hint in the brief didn't pan out for this pair. Not added to mirrors.json; noted here so a future pass doesn't re-spend the same searches.
